name: @protocol-01/circuits
description: Compliance circuits for Protocol 01 — opt-in Groth16 range + sanctions-innocence attestations (consumed by @protocol-01/privacy-sdk ComplianceModule). The shielded-pool / transfer / subscribe circuits were migrated to STARK (@protocol-01/stark-prover) and their circom sources removed.

scripts.setup:range: snarkjs groth16 setup build/compliance_range.r1cs keys/pot20_final.ptau build/compliance_range_0000.zkey
scripts.contribute:range: snarkjs zkey contribute build/compliance_range_0000.zkey build/compliance_range_0001.zkey --name="First contribution" -v
scripts.finalize:range: snarkjs zkey beacon build/compliance_range_0001.zkey build/compliance_range_final.zkey 0102030405060708090a0b0c0d0e0f101112131415161718191a1b1c1d1e1f 10 -n="Final Beacon phase2"
scripts.export-vk:range: snarkjs zkey export verificationkey build/compliance_range_final.zkey build/compliance_range_vk.json
scripts.build:range: npm run compile:range && npm run setup:range && npm run contribute:range && npm run finalize:range && npm run export-vk:range
scripts.setup:innocence: snarkjs groth16 setup build/compliance_innocence.r1cs keys/pot20_final.ptau build/compliance_innocence_0000.zkey
scripts.contribute:innocence: snarkjs zkey contribute build/compliance_innocence_0000.zkey build/compliance_innocence_0001.zkey --name="First contribution" -v
scripts.finalize:innocence: snarkjs zkey beacon build/compliance_innocence_0001.zkey build/compliance_innocence_final.zkey 0102030405060708090a0b0c0d0e0f101112131415161718191a1b1c1d1e1f 10 -n="Final Beacon phase2"
scripts.export-vk:innocence: snarkjs zkey export verificationkey build/compliance_innocence_final.zkey build/compliance_innocence_vk.json
scripts.build:innocence: npm run compile:innocence && npm run setup:innocence && npm run contribute:innocence && npm run finalize:innocence && npm run export-vk:innocence
scripts.build:all: npm run build:range && npm run build:innocence

author: Protocol 01 Team
